Summary (full text)

Camera wyze-t20x-jxf23 (T20) in the light box with the SpyderCheckr 24 chart, lamps 3000 (fair pass, supplement) + 5000 (colour pass) K. Both stacks ran on the same camera, the same chart position and the same light: the open stack (open-tx-isp + OpenIMP + streamer) and the vendor stack (Ingenic ISP module + vendor libimp + streamer built for it), one after the other.

Result: 26 pass, 19 fail (6 invalid by test setup, 4 vendor differences, 1 fixed, 1 accepted, 7 open), 2 info/warn, 11 planned checks not run in these runs.

Failed checks: chart grey BG (AWB, 1.0 = neutral) (open 0.9698, vendor 0.8991; pass = |open - vendor| <= 0.02); p2_a frame luma at the same exposure (open 93.7, vendor 71.9; pass = within +-3 %); p2_a NV12 temporal noise Y (Y 32..224) (open 1.417, vendor 1.232; pass = open <= vendor x (1 + 2 x A/A spread 5 %)); p2_a NV12 temporal noise V (open 0.439, vendor 0.383; pass = open <= vendor x (1 + 2 x A/A spread 5 %)); p2_b frame luma at the same exposure (open 92.4, vendor 55.4; pass = within +-3 %); p2_b NV12 temporal noise Y (Y 32..224) (open 2.037, vendor 1.702; pass = open <= vendor x (1 + 2 x A/A spread 5 %)); p2_c frame luma at the same exposure (open 91.6, vendor 82.3; pass = within +-3 %); p2_c NV12 temporal noise Y (Y 32..224) (open 1.406, vendor 1.152; pass = open <= vendor x (1 + 2 x A/A spread 5 %)).

Passed: frame luma p1_day (AE target, default comp 128); frame luma p1_night (AE target, default comp 128); chart grey RG (AWB, 1.0 = neutral); p2_a NV12 temporal noise U; p2_b NV12 temporal noise U; p2_b NV12 temporal noise V; p2_c NV12 temporal noise U; p2_night NV12 temporal noise Y (Y 32..224); p1_day dE00 mean, unclipped patches; p1_day dE00 mean, grey-normalised; ...

How to read: "pass" means the open stack is equal to or better than the vendor stack within the tolerance named in each row; matched-exposure rows (A2) compare the same integration time and gain on both stacks, read back from the ISP.

Deviations and warnings

6
  • vendor: 04:56:37 preload: libimp symbols missing (SetExpr/GetExpr/SetMaxAgain/SetMaxDgain)
  • box thermometer value was stale (watcher not running): ambient temperature not known for this run
  • Vendor stack: the SDK jxf23 sensor driver sets no line time (one_line_expr_in_us = 0), so the vendor ISP module cannot take a manual integration time; for this pass the vendor sensor module was built with 30 us (the value the SDK's other T20 sensors use). P1 (default AE) is not affected.
  • Matched exposure (P2): the open stack is linear over 2x/4x/8x (frame Y 93.7/92.4/91.6); the vendor stack is not (71.9/55.4/82.3) at the same read-back exposure and gain, so open-vs-vendor brightness and noise at P2 are not comparable point by point (vendor gain-step quirk, as on the T10).
  • Colour 5000 K (P1 day): dE00 to the chart open 11.85 vs vendor 13.27, white-balance-removed 6.95 vs 8.33, saturation C* ratio 0.83 vs 0.62: the open stack is closer to the chart and less washed out; open-vs-vendor dE00 mean 3.2.
  • This protocol is from the night run 2026-11-08 (RC3 image); a complete run with the new runner (encoder, noise curve, substream, AE response, RTSP with credentials) on the next-state image follows and replaces it.

Method

  • Same camera, same chart position, same lamps; open stack first, then the vendor ISP module + vendor libimp are loaded from /tmp (nothing flashed); the camera returns to the flashed image at the end (module reload or reboot).
  • P1 = camera defaults (AE, AWB, comp 128). P2 = matched exposure: the same integration time and gains on both stacks, set inside the streamer and read back from the ISP; rows whose read-back differs are marked verify=FAIL and not compared.
  • A/A: point p2_a is measured twice (p2_a, p2_a2); the relative difference is the repeatability of the method. A difference between the stacks counts only beyond 2 x that spread (floor 5 %).
  • NV12 noise is measured on raw NV12 frames from the streamer (no JPEG in the path): temporal standard deviation per pixel over the burst, mean over Y 32..224, and U/V.
  • Colour: SpyderCheckr 24 detected automatically, sRGB -> Lab (D50), CIEDE2000 against the Datacolor default values (D50 assumed, not batch specific); 'grey-normalised' removes the white-balance cast first.
  • Sharpness: slanted-edge method on the chart's outer patch edges, frames averaged against noise; JPEG snapshot path.
  • SSIM/PSNR (when run): both stacks record the same static chart scene at the same bitrate; each stream is decoded and compared against a high-bitrate capture of the SAME stack (reference), so the number is the encoder loss of that stack; a cross-stack comparison on static frames is listed separately and includes the ISP difference.
  • Encoder (A5): both stacks get the same streamer settings (codec, rc_mode, qp / bitrate, gop) through a /tmp conf and a streamer restart; the recordings come over RTSP (ffmpeg -c copy). The reference is a mean image, because single NV12 frames are not frame-aligned with the stream; the scene is static, so every decoded frame can be compared with it. A second reference at the end of the phase shows whether the scene or the AE moved in between.
  • Lamp switches are made by a person on a marker (NEED_* file); the times above are the marker times.
